title: GitHub Copilot remote control now generally available
source_used: TechGig (fetched directly with curl; the main session's copy was empty)
key_facts: Remote control for GitHub Copilot sessions is now generally available.
Developers can start work in VS Code or the command line (CLI) and finish it from their phone.
The feature is accessible on github.com and through GitHub Mobile.
TechGig published the item on 11 Oct 2026 (3:20 PM IST) and labels it a one-minute read.
quote_evidence: Remote control for GitHub Copilot sessions is now generally available, allowing developers to start work in VS Code or the CLI and finish it from their phone.
This new functionality is accessible on github.com and through GitHub Mobile, providing flexibility for coding workflows.
why_it_matters_hint: Copilot users can carry a coding session from a computer to a phone.
notes: The TechGig item is only a few sentences long and gives no detail on limits, plans or price. GitHub's own changelog post was not found (changelog and feed listed only up to 10 Oct 2026) and Google News showed no other outlet carrying it, so the single short report is all there is.
